The appeal path, quoted from POL-GEN-04

Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

POL-GEN-05: the monetary effect is SGD 13.70 against an execution threshold of SGD 8.00. It exceeds the threshold, so the amount is issued but not executed: it is held for release and the case is placed in the human queue.

The judge's explanation, as written

To the rider and the driver, in plain language. WHAT THE RECORD SHOWS. Trip TRP-02824 is the same trip on all three instruments — trip record, GPS trace and fare breakdown — and the trace's first fix (2026-08-29T16:11:03+08:00) matches the recorded trip_started event. Under POL-RD-01 the governing distance field is gps_trace.trace_distance_km on EV-GPS-02824: 14.4 km. The booked optimal on EV-TRIP-02824 is 2.4 km, so the excess is 12.0 km — 500% of optimal and far above the 0.8 km absolute floor. Both establishment limbs pass, and because the excess also exceeds 50% of optimal and 8.0 km, this is additionally a MATERIAL deviation, which is why the driver's profile was checked. TRACE INTEGRITY. The trace is not impaired for policy purposes: 131 fixes at a 10-second sampling interval, 100.0% coverage, no gaps and a maximum gap of 0.0 s. None of POL-RD-07(a) to (c) is met, so no independent corroboration under POL-RD-07(ii) is required and POL-RD-10(3) is not engaged. The rider's duration point (21.7 min actual against a 5.0 min platform estimate) is consistent with the trace, but distance is decided on the trace figure as POL-RD-01 requires. THE DRIVER'S EXPLANATION. You say the rider changed the destination verbally. POL-RD-04 exonerates a detour only where the rider's instruction is recorded in the chat_log, is timestamped before the vehicle left the optimal corridor (or no more than 3 minutes after) and is corroborated by the trace against chat_message.waypoint_hint. EV-CHAT-02824 is present and complete at weight 1.0, but it holds zero messages: no instruction is recorded, no timestamp exists to test, and the 200 m corroboration test cannot be run. The clause is therefore unavailable, and your account cannot stand in for the chat log because POL-RD-04 names the log as its test, not a party statement. Under POL-RD-08 your assertion points to no artifact that carries it and discharges nothing. POL-RD-05 does not apply either: no pickup or dropoff amendment timestamp is present and amended_optimal_distance_km is null, so there is no re-quote to re-apply. POL-RD-12 does not apply: the vehicle type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so the baseline stays the booked 2.4 km optimal. NO TRAFFIC EXONERATION. The only advisory, EV-ADVIS-02824-01, is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT; it can carry no fact, and its absence is what is cited. No closure-adjusted optimal exists, so no distance is excluded on that ground. THE REFUND ARITHMETIC (POL-RD-02, fare_model METERED). charged_total is $21.48 on EV-FARE-02824. recomputed_fare = (($3.80 base + $0.75 x 2.4 optimal km + $0.28 x 5.0 optimal min) x 1.0 surge, read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier) + $0.80 platform fee + $0.00 ERP and tolls + $0.00 fixed surcharges + $0.00 waiting time - $0.00 promo = $7.80. Refund = $21.48 - $7.80 = $13.68, rounded up to the nearest $0.05, giving $13.70. That is 63.7% of charged_total — below the 90% share at which POL-RD-02 substitutes a full refund, and far above the $0.50 de minimis floor. The rider's demand for the whole $21.48 is therefore not attainable. No ERP or toll line exists on the ledger, so POL-RD-09 adds nothing and the anti-double-count rule has nothing to correct. NO DRIVER COMPENSATION. The billed distance of 14.4 km equals the traced distance, so there is no unbilled-distance shortfall over 1.0 km and the POL-RD-04 compensation limb is not met. Your charge for the distance actually billed stands; the refund corrects only the excess over the optimal route. DRIVER PROFILE CHECK (POL-RD-06). deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 210 completed_trips_90d. Neither limb is met (0 is below 3; 0/210 is below the 0.05 ratio), so no repeat pattern is established: the POL-RD-02 partial is not uplifted to a full refund, and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral arises. The lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags is a near-synonym that POL-GEN-01 makes context only, and it was not used. Symmetrically, the rider's deviation_claims_60d of 1 (0 substantiated) does not raise the corroboration bar under POL-RD-08. Rating, account age, lifetime trips and cancellation rates on either profile were not used as grounds. OUTCOME. Part of the contested amount is returned: PARTIAL_REFUND of $13.70 to the rider. Because that figure exceeds the $8.00 execution threshold, the ruling issues but the amount is held for human release under POL-GEN-05 rather than executed automatically; this is not an escalation and no clause produces a referral here. Under POL-GEN-04 either party may appeal once within 30 days. The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

No independent corroboration under POL-RD-07(ii) is therefore required and POL-RD-10(3) is not engaged.

evidence EV-TRIP-02824 · clauses POL-RD-12, POL-RD-01

kept The refund is arithmetic under POL-RD-02, not discretionary. recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 2.4 + 0.28 x 5.0) x 1.0 surge, read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier) + 0.80 platform fee + 0.00 ERP and tolls + 0.00 fixed surcharges + 0.00 waiting_time_fee - 0.00 promo = SGD 7.80. evidence EV-FARE-02824 · clauses POL-RD-09, POL-RD-02

Under POL-GEN-03 NO_ACTION leaves payment_status and refund_issued_sgd exactly as they are, which on this rider-filed dispute keeps the disputed charge on the rider.

evidence EV-FARE-02824 · clauses POL-GEN-03, POL-RD-02

The check is satisfied and nothing in it reduces the POL-RD-02 sum. Under POL-GEN-01, driver_profile.prior_deviation_flags is a lifetime counter and is not the trailing-90-day field POL-RD-06 names.

evidence EV-DPROF-02824 · clauses POL-RD-06, POL-GEN-01

kept The rider's own profile does not raise the corroboration bar either. rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 1 and rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 0, nowhere near the '4 or more' trigger in POL-RD-08, so no corroboration beyond the gps_trace is required for this claim. Every other field on either profile — rating, account age, lifetime trips, cancellation rates, the lifetime prior_no_show_flags and prior_deviation_flags counters — is context only under POL-GEN-01 and cannot ground a finding.

evidence EV-RPROF-02824 · clauses POL-RD-08, POL-GEN-01

kept The length of the journey is corroborated independently of the trace's distance figure. The trip record records an actual_duration_min of 21.7 against a platform optimal of 5.0 minutes, with trip_started at 16:11:03 and trip_completed at 16:32:43 on a 2.4 km city hop — more than four times the platform's own estimate. That is entirely consistent with the trace's 14.4 km and confirms the excess is a feature of the trip, not an artefact of the sampling.

evidence EV-TRIP-02824, EV-GPS-02824 · clauses POL-RD-08, POL-RD-01

The driver advocate

kept The rider's demand for the whole $21.48 charge is not what this category pays. Read off the fare_breakdown, charged_total is $21.48 and the controlling distance is the trace figure of 14.4 km on EV-GPS-02824, identical to the billed 14.4 km — so the POL-RD-02 recomputation runs against the booked 2.4 km optimal route at the 1.0 surge multiplier recorded on the fare_breakdown: ((3.80 + 0.75 x 2.4 + 0.28 x 5.0) x 1.0) + 0.80 platform fee = $7.80, giving a refund of $13.68 and a rounded payable of $13.70, not $21.48. Billed distance equals traced distance, so there is no unbilled-distance shortfall in the driver's favour to be netted either, and every ledger line is accounted for by distance, time, base fare and platform fee.

evidence EV-FARE-02824, EV-TRIP-02824, EV-GPS-02824 · clauses POL-RD-02, POL-RD-01

kept The $13.68 refund is 63.7% of charged_total (13.68 / 21.48), short of the 90% share at which POL-RD-02 substitutes FULL_REFUND for a partial, so the ceiling on this record is a PARTIAL_REFUND of the contested amount and the rider's asserted $21.48 is not attainable on any line.

evidence EV-FARE-02824 · clauses POL-RD-02

kept No repeat-deviation uplift is open on this trip. POL-RD-06's pattern test runs on two fields and no others — driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d and driver_profile.completed_trips_90d — and the driver's profile shows 0 deviation flags across 210 completed trips in the trailing 90 days: 0 is below the 3-flag limb and 0.00 is below the 0.05 ratio limb, so no pattern is established, the POL-RD-02 partial is not uplifted to a FULL_REFUND of charged_total, and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral arises. The lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags is a near-synonym of deviation_flags_90d and is context only under POL-GEN-01; I do not rely on it.

evidence EV-DPROF-02824, EV-GPS-02824 · clauses POL-RD-06, POL-GEN-01

kept Nothing is added to the distance-and-time figure. The fare_breakdown carries no ERP or toll charge at all — the on-optimal-route and off-optimal-route totals are both $0.00 and erp_gantries is empty — and in any event POL-RD-09(1) provides that off-route ERP is already comprehended in a POL-RD-02 refund and must never be stacked on top of it, so the pass-through correction for this trip is nil.

evidence EV-FARE-02824 · clauses POL-RD-09, POL-RD-02

kept The driver's account is on file — that the rider changed the destination verbally — and I do not stretch it beyond what the record can carry. POL-RD-04 requires an instruction recorded in the chat_log for this trip and corroborated against chat_message.waypoint_hint, and the chat_log records no message at all (EV-CHAT-02824, weight 1.0, 0 messages); POL-RD-05 requires an amended endpoint and the stored amended optimal, and the trip record shows pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at null with amended_optimal_distance_km null, a figure the tribunal is forbidden to derive. Neither clause can exclude any distance on this record, so the excess is measured against the booked 2.4 km optimal route — although the empty chat log neither contradicts the driver's account nor corroborates the rider's.

To the rider and the driver, in plain language. WHAT THE RECORD SHOWS. Trip TRP-02824 is the same trip on all three instruments — trip record, GPS trace and fare breakdown — and the trace's first fix (2026-08-29T16:11:03+08:00) matches the recorded trip_started event. Under POL-RD-01 the governing distance field is gps_trace.trace_distance_km on EV-GPS-02824: 14.4 km. The booked optimal on EV-TRIP-02824 is 2.4 km, so the excess is 12.0 km — 500% of optimal and far above the 0.8 km absolute floor. Both establishment limbs pass, and because the excess also exceeds 50% of optimal and 8.0 km, this is additionally a MATERIAL deviation, which is why the driver's profile was checked. TRACE INTEGRITY. The trace is not impaired for policy purposes: 131 fixes at a 10-second sampling interval, 100.0% coverage, no gaps and a maximum gap of 0.0 s. None of POL-RD-07(a) to (c) is met, so no independent corroboration under POL-RD-07(ii) is required and POL-RD-10(3) is not engaged. The rider's duration point (21.7 min actual against a 5.0 min platform estimate) is consistent with the trace, but distance is decided on the trace figure as POL-RD-01 requires. THE DRIVER'S EXPLANATION. You say the rider changed the destination verbally. POL-RD-04 exonerates a detour only where the rider's instruction is recorded in the chat_log, is timestamped before the vehicle left the optimal corridor (or no more than 3 minutes after) and is corroborated by the trace against chat_message.waypoint_hint. EV-CHAT-02824 is present and complete at weight 1.0, but it holds zero messages: no instruction is recorded, no timestamp exists to test, and the 200 m corroboration test cannot be run. The clause is therefore unavailable, and your account cannot stand in for the chat log because POL-RD-04 names the log as its test, not a party statement. Under POL-RD-08 your assertion points to no artifact that carries it and discharges nothing. POL-RD-05 does not apply either: no pickup or dropoff amendment timestamp is present and amended_optimal_distance_km is null, so there is no re-quote to re-apply. POL-RD-12 does not apply: the vehicle type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so the baseline stays the booked 2.4 km optimal. NO TRAFFIC EXONERATION. The only advisory, EV-ADVIS-02824-01, is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT; it can carry no fact, and its absence is what is cited. No closure-adjusted optimal exists, so no distance is excluded on that ground. THE REFUND ARITHMETIC (POL-RD-02, fare_model METERED). charged_total is $21.48 on EV-FARE-02824. recomputed_fare = (($3.80 base + $0.75 x 2.4 optimal km + $0.28 x 5.0 optimal min) x 1.0 surge, read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier) + $0.80 platform fee + $0.00 ERP and tolls + $0.00 fixed surcharges + $0.00 waiting time - $0.00 promo = $7.80. Refund = $21.48 - $7.80 = $13.68, rounded up to the nearest $0.05, giving $13.70. That is 63.7% of charged_total — below the 90% share at which POL-RD-02 substitutes a full refund, and far above the $0.50 de minimis floor. The rider's demand for the whole $21.48 is therefore not attainable. No ERP or toll line exists on the ledger, so POL-RD-09 adds nothing and the anti-double-count rule has nothing to correct. NO DRIVER COMPENSATION. The billed distance of 14.4 km equals the traced distance, so there is no unbilled-distance shortfall over 1.0 km and the POL-RD-04 compensation limb is not met. Your charge for the distance actually billed stands; the refund corrects only the excess over the optimal route. DRIVER PROFILE CHECK (POL-RD-06). deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 210 completed_trips_90d. Neither limb is met (0 is below 3; 0/210 is below the 0.05 ratio), so no repeat pattern is established: the POL-RD-02 partial is not uplifted to a full refund, and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral arises. The lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags is a near-synonym that POL-GEN-01 makes context only, and it was not used. Symmetrically, the rider's deviation_claims_60d of 1 (0 substantiated) does not raise the corroboration bar under POL-RD-08. Rating, account age, lifetime trips and cancellation rates on either profile were not used as grounds. OUTCOME. Part of the contested amount is returned: PARTIAL_REFUND of $13.70 to the rider. Because that figure exceeds the $8.00 execution threshold, the ruling issues but the amount is held for human release under POL-GEN-05 rather than executed automatically; this is not an escalation and no clause produces a referral here. Under POL-GEN-04 either party may appeal once within 30 days.

Rider, your complaint is substantially upheld. Driver, the record does not carry your account. Here is the reasoning, with the figures. THE DEVIATION IS ESTABLISHED AND MATERIAL (POL-RD-01). The governing distance is the GPS trace, not the trip record's rounded copy. EV-GPS-02824 records 14.4 km (trace_distance_km) against the booked optimal of 2.4 km on EV-TRIP-02824, an excess of 12.0 km — 500% of optimal and 12.0 km absolute. Both POL-RD-01 limbs therefore pass (over 20% and over 0.8 km), and because the excess exceeds 50% of optimal and 8.0 km absolute it is additionally a MATERIAL deviation. The trace is NOT impaired, either for policy purposes or at schema level: EV-GPS-02824 is COMPLETE at weight 1.0 and carries 131 fixes at a 10-second interval with 100.0% coverage, no gaps and a maximum gap of 0.0 seconds, so there is no POL-RD-07(a), (b) or (c) defect and no independent corroboration under POL-RD-07(ii) is needed. POL-RD-10(3) is not engaged. The rider's initial burden under POL-RD-08 is discharged: trip_id TRP-02824 matches across trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown, the trace's first fix (16:11:03) matches the recorded trip_started event, and the excess clears the POL-RD-01 threshold on an unimpaired trace. The burden shifted to the driver, and nothing discharges it. NO EXONERATION. POL-RD-03 fails: the only traffic advisory, EV-ADVIS-02824-01, is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, so no advisory names a road the optimal route traverses, no validity window and no alternative distance exist, and no closure-adjusted optimal can be built. No party asserted an external traffic cause, so that absence is a gap in the bundle and not a POL-RD-10(5) escalation. POL-RD-04 fails on every limb: EV-CHAT-02824 holds zero messages (message_count 0, first_message_at and last_message_at null), so there is no rider instruction, no instruction timestamp to test under POL-RD-04(b) and no chat_message.waypoint_hint from which the 200 m corroboration test could be run — the clause is unavailable. POL-RD-05 fails: pickup_amended_at, dropoff_amended_at, original_pickup, original_dropoff and amended_optimal_distance_km are all null, so there is no amended endpoint and no stored re-quote, and the tribunal may not derive one. POL-RD-12 does not apply: vehicle_type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so the baseline remains the booked 2.4 km optimal. DRIVER, YOUR STATEMENT THAT THE RIDER CHANGED THE DESTINATION VERBALLY CARRIES NO WEIGHT. It cites no evidence ID and no artifact records any such instruction; under POL-RD-08 an assertion that cites nothing and is corroborated by nothing discharges no burden and does not reduce the excess. I note, as your advocate fairly put it, that the empty chat log does not positively contradict you — but the absence of a record is not evidence of the thing you assert, and no clause (POL-RD-04, POL-RD-05) reads a counterparty statement as the test for a rider-requested detour. THE REFUND IS ARITHMETIC (POL-RD-02). recomputed_fare = ((3.80 base + 0.75 x 2.4 optimal km + 0.28 x 5.0 optimal min) x the 1.0 surge multiplier read from EV-FARE-02824) + 0.80 platform fee + 0.00 ERP/tolls on the optimal route + 0.00 fixed surcharges + 0.00 waiting time - 0.00 promo = SGD 7.80. charged_total = SGD 21.48. Refund = 21.48 - 7.80 = SGD 13.68, which is 63.69% of charged_total — above the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor, below the 90% share that would substitute FULL_REFUND, so this is a PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 13.70 after rounding up to the nearest SGD 0.05. Rider, your demand for the whole 21.48 is not attainable on any line; 13.68 is 63.7%, short of the 90% full-refund share. Nothing is added on top: erp_gantries is empty and both ERP totals are 0.00, so POL-RD-09(1) has nothing to stack and the pass-through correction is nil. NO DRIVER COMPENSATION. The POL-RD-04 unbilled-distance limb requires the fare_breakdown to bill less distance than the trace records; here the billed 14.4 km equals the traced 14.4 km, so there is no shortfall to pay and driver_compensation_sgd is null. NO REFERRAL. The POL-RD-06 check is run because the deviation is MATERIAL, and it yields nothing: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 210 completed_trips_90d, below both the 3-flag limb and the 0.05 ratio limb, so no pattern is established, no FULL_REFUND uplift arises and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct review is produced.
